finding: `node atm.mjs git commit --dry-run --auto-stage` reported and created commit `393d65a3b07b2715aa178d3aa546ed503bdbbf9c` during ATM-GOV-0271 closeout instead of remaining non-mutating.
expectedBehavior: The dry-run path must not create commits, advance HEAD, stage new files, or mutate git-head evidence. It should only resolve and report the task-scoped commit bundle.
evidenceOrRepro: Command: `node atm.mjs git commit --actor codex-skl-captain --task ATM-GOV-0271 --message "feat(taskflow): add close saga recovery lanes" --auto-stage --dry-run --json`; output included `ATM_GIT_COMMIT_OK` and commit `393d65a3b07b2715aa178d3aa546ed503bdbbf9c`.
followUp: Add a regression test for git commit dry-run non-mutation, including HEAD-before/after equality and empty commit creation assertions.
